stream.studio_title_note: Title in YouTube Studio (Rediger) can differ slightly; video ID MBjG7hq_YZA must stay the same broadcast.

obs.note: Capture the monitor in stream layout; keep chat on-site rail, not in OBS browser.

discord.setup_note: Set DISCORD_CHANNEL_ID_GENERAL to your main chat room webhook URL (Server Settings → Integrations → Webhooks). Falls back to DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL. YouTube link unfurls in chat; monitor opens via embed link.

youtube_live_setup: Studio shows 'Ingen data' until OBS sends RTMP — editing title (Rediger) alone does not go live.
OBS → Settings → Stream → Service YouTube / Custom → Server rtmp://a.rtmp.youtube.com/live2 → Stream key from Studio (Streamindstillinger).
Click 'Start streaming' in OBS; Studio should switch from Ingen data to receiving video, then click Go live.
Broadcast ID for site embed + Discord: MBjG7hq_YZA — if you create a new broadcast, update youtube_video_id and redeploy.
Never commit the stream key — only set YOUTUBE_STREAM_KEY in server .env for ops scripts if needed.
studio_edit_da: Rediger = metadata only (titel, kategori, miniature). Det starter ikke streamen.
Kopiér streamnøgle under Streamindstillinger → indsæt i OBS under Stream.
Når OBS sender video, forsvinder 'Ingen data' og du kan gå live.
Brug samme udsendelse (video-ID i URL) som på sitet: MBjG7hq_YZA
